name: MCP for Unity
summary: MIT bridge between MCP clients and the Unity Editor: 50 tools to create scenes and GameObjects, edit C# scripts, manage assets, run tests and build.
description: Install as a Unity package from `https://github.com/CoplayDev/unity-mcp.git?path=/MCPForUnity#main` (or `openupm add com.coplaydev.unity-mcp`), then `Window → MCP for Unity → Configure All Detected Clients`. Requires Unity 2021.3 LTS to 6.x and Python 3.10+ via uv. Supports multiple Unity instances, tool groups (vfx, animation, ui, testing), Roslyn script validation and a remote-hosted server with auth. Sponsored and maintained by Aura (Coplay). Latest release v10.3.0 (2026-10-04).

agent_access.notes: Local stdio server talking to the Unity Editor; remote hosting with auth is documented separately.
